exact_statement: Fix even k>=2 and arbitrary depth L>=1, with disjoint fresh k-bit quadratic bent data, a fair selector and r_j>=0 fresh point controls at each level. Let E0=1, Ej=Aj[(1-bj)/2+1_{xj=0} yj E(j-1)], and Fj=1-2Ej. For every complete physical restriction tree that queries the outermost r_L controls before any other coordinate, at strict badness threshold B_i>4 Inf_i, the localized odd-face charge satisfies Q_bad,4(T)<= (1/2+5/k) I(F_L)<=3 I(F_L), irrespective of all subsequent coordinate choices. The exact probability/influence/odd-face recurrences are (1) in PROOF.md. Exact outward-log certificates cover 31 frozen families and their four named complete orders, plus independent direct reproduction of 16 ledgers. This is a uniform-in-depth result for the stated tower and does not establish the universal existential bridge, overlapping controls or FEI.
